title: Candidate pattern: executable architecture invariants
summary: Turn important architectural boundaries and repository rules into focused checks that fail close to the violating change, while keeping human rationale in architecture and contributor documentation.
incompatible_when: The invariant is subjective, unstable, or cannot be checked without unacceptable false positives.
procedure: State the boundary and rationale in architecture or contributor documentation.
Implement the smallest deterministic check that detects a violation.
Add a focused test for the check itself, including a known failing fixture when practical.
Wire the check to the narrowest CI gate that owns the affected risk.
Keep exception lists explicit, reviewed, and shrink-only.
verification: Demonstrate that a representative violation fails with an actionable message and that compliant code passes.
Confirm the CI workflow actually invokes the check on relevant changes.
rollback: Demote a noisy gate to advisory while fixing its signal; do not silently delete the documented invariant.

confidence.rationale: OmniRoute has extensive documented and executable checks, but this generalized pattern still requires external reuse evidence.
